title: AuditEntryRecordedPayload
description: Payload of the AuditEntryRecorded platform event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8, §28.18; class: platform; FR-AH.15). Written in the same transaction as the change it records (ARC-05). Authored by INV-T-2855 (T11). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

actor.description: Who or what made the change — a principal identifier, or a system actor for an automated change.

action.description: The action recorded, e.g. the use case name (TPL-04's AuditEntry.of call site).

scope.description: The entity or resource the action concerns.

reason.description: Why the action was taken, absent when none was given.

priorState.description: The state before the change, absent when there is none to record (opaque; interpreted by evidence-svc).
